# Ajar Gurung

> Ajar Gurung is a storyteller, social media specialist and serial entrepreneur based in Kathmandu, Nepal, originally from Pokhara. Ajar builds brands and short-form content, and has founded Buzzing Bees (a social media marketing agency), Ajar Real Estate (property video marketing) and Nawa Niwas (Nepal's zero commission rental marketplace). A fourth venture, Project Offline, is in the works.

Ajar Gurung's work has generated 10M+ views across client and personal accounts, including a restaurant reel with over 1.4M views. Ajar won the International Business Olympiad 2022 and gold and silver medals at the Nepal Economics Olympiad 2023.

Contact: gurungazar@gmail.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ajar-gurung/

## Ventures

### Nawa Niwas (नव निवास)
- Nepal's zero commission rental marketplace: https://www.nawaniwas.com
- Landlords list rooms, flats, houses, shutters and offices for free; renters contact landlords directly. Agency listings are marked.
- Free for renters and landlords, with no commission on either side. Revenue is planned from ads by moving, cleaning, plumbing and electrical services.
- Launched 20 September 2026. As of October 2026: 142 live listings across 8 cities, and 100+ listings within 18 days of launch.
- Also offers rent price guides for Kathmandu and Lalitpur, and a service where the team creates a listing for landlords who call in.

### Buzzing Bees
- Social media marketing agency for brands and professionals in Nepal and beyond.
- Services: content strategy, short-form video (Reels and TikToks), social media management, analysis and reporting.
- Results: a debut TikTok for Whitehouse Enterprises passed 107K views with no paid promotion; a real estate video for Lama Realtor passed 145K organic views; Thamel's Instagram grew from 700 to 1,100+ followers in four months; Santiago Hermoza's LinkedIn grew from 164 to 500+ followers in a month.

### Ajar Real Estate
- Property video marketing in Nepal, built to bring property sellers real leads, not just views.
- Process: script, shoot, edit, then boost with targeted ads so the right buyers in the right area see each listing.
- Results: a house tour in Naya Gaun, Pokhara passed 320K organic views on TikTok and generated 500+ leads; an Instagram reel reached almost 50K views through paid ads and generated 150+ leads.
